label: Kinetic Text
description: Editorial text line with the house entrance: the whole line rises ~10px and fades in (~300ms). No per-word effects. Emphasis via *stars* = brand-color accent, color only.

text.label: Text. Wrap key words in *stars* to accent them in brand color.

color.label: Text color override (CSS color). Default is the brand text color -- on dark scenes set an explicit light color, e.g. #f5f6fa.

mode.label: LEGACY (ignored): all text now enters as a whole line

effect.label: LEGACY (ignored): the house line-rise is the only entrance
